# Family Armor of God (Ephesians 6:11)

## Emotional Focus
Putting on God’s armor together as a family.

## Key KJV
“Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand.” (Ephesians 6:11)

## Gentle Retelling
God gives families the armor of truth, righteousness, peace, faith, and prayer so we can stand strong together at home.

## Coloring Prompt
A family standing side by side with gentle pieces of armor (shield, sword, helmet) in soft light.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“We can put on God’s armor together every day.”
